name: default
description: RankBind full model: balanced sampler + within-ligand margin loss + bilinear-only head.

triplet.negative_sampling_note: v4: hard-negative mining. Before each epoch, re-score all (positive-ligand × train-protein) pairs with the current model. For anchor (L+, P+), take top-hard_pool_size proteins by score excluding known positives + anchor, then sample k uniformly from that pool. Falls back to random cross_protein_implicit at epoch 0 (scores not yet cached).

model.capacity_note: bilinear_rank=128 matches MLP-concat head parameter count (65,793) for fair head comparison; see v5_rankbind/PLAN.md §head-capacity.
